reactions.name: THERMAL SHATTER!
reactions.effect: Steam cloud that blocks vision; cancels opposite charges with thermal shock.

reactions.name: INFERNO VORTEX!
reactions.effect: Fire grows and spreads in the wind direction; creates a fire tornado.

reactions.name: BLAZING DETONATION!
reactions.effect: Ignites oil or alcohol into an explosive shockwave.

reactions.name: MELTDOWN SURGE!
reactions.effect: Melts solid ice barriers into conductive water.

reactions.name: ARC FLOOD!
reactions.effect: Electrifies the water surface, doubling damage and chaining further.

reactions.name: CONDUCTIVE OVERLOAD!
reactions.effect: Seeks armored metal targets for double damage and extended chain.

reactions.name: GLACIAL BRIDGE!
reactions.effect: Freezes water into walkable ice that can trap vessels or swimmers.

reactions.name: INSTANT FREEZE!
reactions.effect: Freezes wet targets solid; heavy hits shatter frozen foes.

reactions.name: MAGMA CATAPULT!
reactions.effect: Molten rock projectile that burns on physical impact.

reactions.name: RIME BLIZZARD!
reactions.effect: Freezing gale vortex that slows and blinds.

reactions.name: SUPERCONDUCT SHATTER!
reactions.effect: Brittle superconducting discharge that staggers and chains.

reactions.name: TEMPEST CELL!
reactions.effect: Storm cell vortex that discharges erratic lightning arcs.
